subject: Discovery recap — confirm priority & next step
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ana Soto <ana@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T16:15:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap — confirm priority & next step

Hi Ana,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today — really appreciated the openness about BluePeak's inference bottlenecks and compliance constraints. I captured the key points below so we're aligned and to make it easy to share with your stakeholders.

Summary from today's call:
- Current pain: inconsistent latency for batch scoring and no reliable autoscaling; spikes during reporting windows (1–2 hours/day) are most painful.
- Data sensitivity: PII in inputs; requirement for customer-managed keys and audit logs for any pilot.
- Success criteria for a pilot: 80% reduction in tail latency for the 99th percentile; token cost below your current vendor baseline; ability to run in your VPC for the pilot.

Proposed next step:
- 6-week technical pilot (limited dataset) + one integration day for key management and observability hooks.
- Deliverables: latency and cost dashboard, rollout runbook, and a short exec summary after week 4.

Attachments: discovery-recap.pdf (summary + notes), MAP-draft.xlsx (mutual action plan — editable).

Can you confirm whether the pilot timing is still a priority for BluePeak and whether the team has any hard constraints on start dates (e.g., procurement/PO windows)? If this is lower priority, let us know and we can adjust cadence.

If it helps, here's a 30-minute slot to lock in next steps: https://calendly.com/kimberly_park/30min

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

If you can send those two items I can push this through a short internal review next week and get back with timing.
